items.title: Write canonical scope-boundary v1.1 for new Stories while preserving historical v1 reads
items.context: Change the canonical writer to emit exactly proof-or-stop.scope_boundary.v1.1. Readers and hash verification must continue to accept already persisted lattice.scope_boundary.v1 without rewriting historical bytes. A direct string replacement of signed history is forbidden.
items.userSees: Fresh Story scope-boundary JSON shows schemaVersion proof-or-stop.scope_boundary.v1.1.

items.title: Reject retired INIT reviewer identities from new Story evidence
items.context: New init_check_set evidence and INIT_CHECK admission must use proof-or-stop-review-story-init plus product-reviewer. Retired lattice-* agent IDs may remain observable only in historical artifacts; they must not be generated, mapped into a permitted reviewer identity, or accepted as new canonical evidence.
items.userSees: Fresh INIT evidence names proof-or-stop-review-story-init and rejects the retired reviewer name.

items.title: Fail closed when a Story writer executes from a foreign worktree runtime
items.context: Promote the existing doctor cli-entrypoint/global-core-realpath diagnosis into one shared mutation-admission policy consumed by every story-scoped mutating command enumerated from the canonical command-policy/dispatch registry. If the executing Proof-or-Stop core resolves to a different worktree/project runtime, stop before writing. Preserve legitimate installed-package use in external consumer repositories. Contract tests must prove registry coverage cannot silently omit a Story writer, and an end-to-end foreign-runtime rejection must prove zero bytes and zero refs changed.
items.userSees: A mismatched global CLI stops with a repair command before changing Story files.

items.title: Keep the identity verifier green after DONE release-ledger writes
items.context: B-022e passed the identity verifier before DONE, then its artifact/product capability release records introduced unclassified retired path tokens. Make release provenance classification or post-write verification fail closed so DONE cannot leave the identity-cutover contract red.
items.userSees: DONE completes only when the post-release identity verification remains green.

items.title: Prove every registered active identity field in fresh Story JSON is canonical
items.context: Land focused RED tests before production changes. Define one bounded Story JSON identity-field registry/inventory covering every field that carries an active product, schema, role, command, environment, config, or runtime identity. An end-to-end temporary-repository test must create a fresh Story, write scope and both INIT reviewer records, scan every registered field, and assert schemaVersion proof-or-stop.scope_boundary.v1.1, agentId proof-or-stop-review-story-init, rejection of retired Agent IDs, foreign-runtime write refusal, historical v1 read compatibility, and post-release identity verifier success. Historical narrative/provenance fields remain explicitly outside the active identity registry.
items.userSees: The test report proves newly generated Story JSON contains only canonical active identities.
